name: hostify-appliance
description: Hostify - Turnkey Personal Music Cloud Setup Wizard & Management Dashboard

scripts.build:server: esbuild server/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/server.bundle.cjs --external:vite --external:bytenode --external:http-proxy-middleware && bytenode -c dist/server.bundle.cjs && rm dist/server.bundle.cjs && node -e "fs.writeFileSync('dist/index.cjs', 'require(\"bytenode\");\nrequire(\"./server.bundle.jsc\");\n')"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:client && pnpm run build:server
